status: proposal awaiting one more review before it is made final and regenerated for real. production data/synthetic/v5/ and data/processed/v5/logistics/agent_calibration.csv are untouched by it
purpose: a proposed 12-agent logistics calibration: every F and alpha recomputed from a pinned raw record, every weight domain with an explicit minimum and maximum, every assignment traced to the agent's own v4 specialty text
model: every agent prices with the continuous F + alpha x kg + beta x (kg / 1000) x km, then the shared fuel surcharge, damage, priority and USD conversion as in production. no agent uses a discrete tariff lookup
role_of_proposal: the proposal as specified: large and bulk specialists take the 1000-1500 kg segment, the first near-flat Lavarahti segment
eligibility_rule: eligible when min_shipment_weight_kg <= weight and weight <= max_shipment_weight_kg (or < when max_weight_inclusive is false). Lavarahti segments are half-open because the next bracket starts at the maximum; the price list states no rounding rule for chargeable weight, so a fractional weight just below a bracket start stays in the lower segment

safeguard_findings: the bracket tables do not end at a service maximum. Service Point and Parcel Locker brackets stop at '30,01 - 35 kg', followed by '€/1 kg 0,27' and 'If the freight weight exceeds 35 kg, an extra fee for every following kilogram applies (€/1 kg).'; MyPack Home and Parcel B2B print '0-30 kg' with 'If the freight weight exceeds 30 kg, an extra fee for every following kilogram applies'

the price list states no maximum weight: 'You can find the parcel size limits and more specific shipping instructions in the special terms and conditions document that can be found on our website.' that document was not read, so no PostNord service limit is evidenced here
postnord.decision: not used. PostNord is only for an agent whose specialty gives a reason to differ from a Posti duplicate, and neither L06 nor L12 does, see parcel_duplicates

parcel_duplicates.L06: names the same budget tier as L03 ('lowest base cost' against L03's 'cheapest base cost'); its 'central and northern' wording is its service_regions, not a different service. no reason to leave Posti: honest duplication of L03's Postal Parcel reading
parcel_duplicates.L12: 'careful' and 'second lowest damage' are handling risk, which its damage_probability already carries, and 'light loads' is the parcel corner itself. it names no service tier, so it takes the standard doorstep product, Home Parcel: honest duplication of L10's reading

parcel_corner.db_schenker_dsv: dropped from consideration by the supervisor: its only published Finland domestic table caps at 99 kg across several packages of under 30 kg each, a multi-package limit a single shipment_weight_kg cannot represent

freight_corner.rule: size language in the agent's own v4 specialty text: large or bulk words take the heavy segment, small words the sub-1000 kg segment, medium words alone a mid-weight Posti Express Freight reading, no size words the sub-1000 kg segment. agents with no documented size specialization share a reading; that duplication is the intended, honest outcome
